sections.How To Use:
Clean Your Face: Start with a clean face. Use your regular cleanser to remove any impurities or makeup.
Apply the Mask: Align the mask with your facial features (eyes, nose, mouth) and place it smoothly over your face. Press gently to ensure it adheres properly.
Relax and Enjoy: Leave the mask on for 15-20 minutes. Take this time to relax and let the mask work its magic.
Remove and Massage: Gently peel off the mask from your face. Massage any remaining essence into your skin using upward and outward motions until fully absorbed.
Follow-Up Care: For best results, follow up with your usual skincare routine, such as applying moisturizer to lock in the hydration.

Caution:
External use only. Avoid contact with eyes.
Discontinue use if irritation occurs.
Keep out of reach of children.
For Sensitive Skin: Perform a patch test on a small area before use.
